@@U02893@@
reminding me of the joke I played on that poor lad some years ago, confusing his mind with my mock-serious nonsense. I suspect he’s still gnawing on that bone. Well, old moth-eaten friend, I must confess I feel the urge to wrap myself again in your furry warmth and play the professor once more, utterly confident that only he is right. Academics know how to carry off that farce, but unfortunately the Devil lost it long ago. (He shakes the robe he has taken down, and crickets, beetles, and moths fly out.)

@@U02895@@
We welcome your coming, Old patron and friend; With buzzing and humming On you we attend. Singly, in silence, You planted us here, Swarming by thousands, To you we appear! The rogue in the bosom Hides close in his lair; Our fur bed we gladly Forsake for the air.

@@U02897@@
Ah! What a grand surprise! My youthful creation! Sow as you will and in time you'll reap. But let me shake this ragtag robe once more and see if there’s any left.

@@U02898@@
(He shakes the robe.)
translation:
@@U02893@@
让我想起几年前我对那个可怜的小伙子开的玩笑，用我假装严肃的胡言乱语混淆了他的思想。我怀疑他还在啃那根骨头。好吧，老朋友，我必须承认，我有一种冲动，想再次把自己包裹在你毛茸茸的温暖中，再次扮演教授，完全相信只有他是对的。学者们知道如何上演这场闹剧，但不幸的是魔鬼早已失去了它。 （他一抖脱下来的袍子，蟋蟀、甲虫和飞蛾就飞了出来。）

@@U02895@@
老顾客、老朋友，我们欢迎您的光临；我们伴随着你的嗡嗡声和嗡嗡声参加。独自一人，默默无闻，您将我们种植在这里，成千上万的人蜂拥而至，我们向您显现！怀里的流氓 隐藏在他的巢穴里；我们很乐意放弃我们的毛皮床，去呼吸新鲜空气。

@@U02897@@
啊！多么大的惊喜啊！我的青春创作！只要你愿意播种，迟早你就会收获。不过，让我再抖一下这件破烂的长袍，看看还有没有剩下的。

@@U02898@@
（他摇晃长袍。）
